title: Neon Pulse — Episode 37: Abyssal Stand
description: Trapped in a sunken alien chamber while Commander Vance's strike team closes in, Kael prepares for a desperate final stand.
character_reference: a tall, lean man with messy dark hair, wearing a worn charcoal-grey tactical jacket with glowing amber circuitry patterns running down his sleeves
